title: solution.tex Statement 2: arithmetic slip in the beta bound (7 eps^2 vs 9 eps^2)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** solution.tex, Statement 2, equation \eqref{eq:beta}.

The bound is written $\beta=w\le 3(\tfrac\mu2+\eps^2)+2\cdot\eps^2+2\cdot2\eps^2=\tfrac{3\mu}{2}+7\eps^2$.

The $\eps^2$-coefficient is $3$ (three wide triangles) $+2$ (two outer parallelograms $S'_\pm$, short side $\eps^2$) $+4$ (two inner parallelograms $R'_\pm$, short side $2\eps^2$) $=9$, **not** $7$. Correct bound: $\beta\le\tfrac{3\mu}{2}+9\eps^2$.

The conclusion $\beta<\sqrt3+\eps$ is unaffected (for $\eps<1/100$, $9\eps^2<9\eps/100<\eps$), but the printed constant should be corrected to $9\eps^2$.
